title: Commercial Director Chartering
description:
About the position
As Commercial Director, you define and execute Jifmar’s global chartering and market development strategy. You report to executive management, operate at group level, are part of the management team in the Netherlands and lead an international sales team of four.
Jifmar is operationally strong, financially stable and internationally active. The challenge is not restructuring, but enhancing performance, growth, strengthening strategic consistency and increasing long-term commercial value creation.
The fleet serves offshore wind, oil & gas, marine infrastructure, governmental and port-related markets. The commercial focus is on utilisation, day rates, contract quality and margin optimisation across regions and market cycles.
The organisation operates from The Netherlands and internationally with offices in France, Scotland and Dubai and has an experienced commercial team. The next phase requires sharper prioritisation, stronger global alignment and more structured portfolio management across jurisdictions.
In the coming years, emphasis will be placed on balancing spot exposure with long-term contracts, optimising fleet allocation and strengthening pipeline predictability. This requires clear choices in pricing, contract governance, regional focus and asset deployment.
Your role is to provide clarity and direction. You ensure market strategy, fleet planning and commercial execution are aligned, set priorities and ensure consistent implementation across the organisation.
You lead and align international business development and sales activities across regions, driving performance against KPIs including utilisation, day rates, margin contribution and backlog development.
The culture is entrepreneurial and direct, with decisions made close to the business. The next phase requires stronger coordination, transparent reporting and consistent commercial discipline while maintaining the organisation’s agility.

Your profile
You hold a relevant degree in Maritime Studies, Engineering or Business.
You bring extensive international experience in chartering, commercial management or business development within the maritime sector, with a strong track record in complex charter agreements and profitable growth in cyclical markets.
You are strategically and analytically strong and capable of defining direction without losing sight of operational realities.
Connecting long-term market positioning with short-term execution.
You are entrepreneurial by nature and focused on expanding and strengthening the business.

About the organisation
Founded in 2005, Jifmar Group has developed into an established international maritime services provider. With more than 850 employees operating across three continents, the company delivers turnkey solutions in offshore wind, oil & gas, defence, subsea inspection, marine infrastructure and port services.
From a strong operational foundation, Jifmar has built a solid international market position in project-driven maritime segments. The organisation combines entrepreneurial drive with technical depth and a modern, versatile fleet deployed worldwide. Jifmar is organized in two business units; Solutions and Chartering. For the Business Unit Chartering we are now looking for a Commercial Director.
The strength of Jifmar lies in the integration of commercial insight, operational capability and asset ownership. Chartering, technical management and project execution are closely connected. This creates control over quality, risk allocation and long-term positioning in complex international markets.
Over the past years, the company has realised significant international growth, both organically and through expansion of fleet capabilities. The organisation has matured further, processes have become more structured and reporting lines clearer, while maintaining a pragmatic and hands-on culture.
Jifmar is now at a logical development stage. The fundamentals are strong and market opportunities, particularly in offshore renewables, are substantial. The next phase requires sharper commercial alignment, global coordination and strategic optimisation of fleet deployment.
Following the departure of the long-standing commercial leader after fifteen years, Jifmar seeks a Commercial Director / Head of Chartering to further strengthen its global commercial positioning and drive sustainable, profitable growth.

title: Manager Strategic Accounts
description:
About the position
The Manager Strategic Accounts is responsible for the end-to-end commercial ownership of Chane’s most strategic customers within the segments Fuels & Chemicals and Low Carbon Fuels. Serving Platinum customers, accounting for more than 50% of Chane’s total revenue, the role focuses on building strategic partnerships with a strong emphasis on deeper supply chain integration and long-term growth. This requires a deep understanding of customer supply chains and the ability to translate this into integrated storage and service solutions across Chane’s European terminal network.
Acting as the single point of accountability, the Manager Strategic Accounts drives growth through both expansion of existing business and identification of new opportunities across terminals, products and value-added services. The role orchestrates internal stakeholders across commercial, operational and support functions to deliver a seamless and high-quality customer experience. The Manager Strategic Accounts has full end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic accounts, including direct accountability for revenue and margin performance.
In doing so, the Manager Strategic Accounts plays a key role in shifting Chane from an asset-driven organization to a customer-centric, strategically aligned commercial platform, contributing directly to long-term growth and market leadership ambitions.

Your profile
Managed complex, multi-site strategic accounts (€10M+ scope)
Deep expertise in supply chains, terminals, and storage economics
Strong track record in both hunting new business and growing key accounts
Commercially sharp: pricing, margins, contracts, and profitability
Influential stakeholder manager within complex matrix organizations

About the organisation
Chane is a European liquid bulk storage partner operating at the heart of industrial and energy supply chains. With a network of 21 terminals across 6 countries, the company provides critical infrastructure and services that enable customers to store, handle and move essential liquid products safely, efficiently and reliably.
Chane serves a diversified customer base of approximately 120 clients, ranging from large multinational corporations to mid-sized industrial players. These customers operate in sectors such as fuels, chemicals and emerging energy carriers, where supply chain reliability and operational excellence are business-critical. Chane combines strong local operational expertise with an increasing focus on central coordination and commercial excellence.
With the appointment of a new CEO, Chane has sharpened its ambition and strategic direction. The company is transitioning from a network of largely autonomous terminals towards a more integrated European platform, supported by changes in the operating model and a more structured, data-driven way of working. The commercial organization is being strengthened, with a clearer focus on strategic account management, customer segmentation and value-based selling.
This transformation is driven by a clear ambition: to become the leading tank storage company in Europe. Key priorities include expanding capacity, strengthening customer partnerships and building a more customer-centric commercial platform, supported by selective M&A to accelerate growth.
At the core of Chane’s culture are five values that guide behaviour and decision-making across the organization: Keep earning, Be safe, Look to solve, Make sure and Dare to execute.
Together, these elements define Chane as a company in transition, evolving from a strong operational backbone to a fully integrated, commercially driven and future-oriented European platform, positioned at the intersection of industrial storage and the energy transition.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the position
The Marketing Manager is accountable for defining and driving Chane’s strategic marketing agenda across all businesses, including Storage, PID (industrial distillation unit), and associated services.
The role ensures Chane has a clear, differentiated and monetisable market proposition, grounded in robust market and customer insights, translated into compelling Customer Value Propositions (CVPs), a structured Offer Book, and disciplined pricing strategies and tools.
The Marketing Manager acts as a strategic partner to the wider Commercial and Corporate Teams, supporting sustainable growth and value creation across the portfolio. This is a new role in the company. It is an opportunity for an experienced marketing professional to build and grow the Marketing function, being a key enabler for Chane's transformational growth journey.
The role is reporting to the CCO It is expected that this person will over time grow a small marketing team.

Your profile
Experience in marketing, strategy or pricing in B2B industries
Translates technical capabilities into market propositions
Industry knowledge in storage, terminals or chemicals
Track record in managing and structuring offer portfolios
Experience with value-based selling and pricing models
Builds and scales marketing in growing organisations

About the organisation
Chane is a European liquid bulk storage partner at the heart of industrial and energy supply chains. With 21 terminals across 6 countries, the company enables customers to store, handle and move essential liquid products safely, efficiently and reliably. Serving leading players in fuels, chemicals and emerging energy markets, Chane combines strong local expertise with a growing focus on commercial excellence.
With a new CEO in place, Chane is accelerating its transformation into a more integrated and customer-centric European platform. A strengthened commercial approach, focused on strategic accounts and value-based partnerships, is key to this next phase of growth.
In this context, the Marketing Manager plays a key role in positioning Chane credibly at the intersection of industrial storage and the energy transition.
With the ambition to become Europe’s number one tank storage company, supported by expansion and selective M&A, Chane offers a unique opportunity to make real impact in a dynamic, international environment.
